htmlTitle: Fruit Destroy — Free Fruit Matching Arcade Game Online
playTitle: Play Fruit Destroy — Free Online Fruit Matching Game
metaDescription: Match pairs of fruit, chain combos and shoo hungry critters before they eat your fruit! Play Fruit Destroy free in your browser — levels, Endless mode and a Daily Challenge.
ogTitle: Fruit Destroy — Match fruit, beat the critters!
ogDescription: Free fruit-matching arcade game. Chain combos, shoo hungry animals, beat your friends.
lead: Fruit Destroy is a fast fruit-matching arcade game. Find two of the same fruit, toss them into the basket and chain combos — before the monkey grabs your bananas.

steps.title: Tap two that match
steps.body: Pick a fruit, then find its twin. Matched pairs fly straight into your basket.

steps.title: Chain combos
steps.body: Match again within 3 seconds to build a combo: ×1.2, ×1.5, ×2 — all the way to ×3.

steps.title: Shoo the critters
steps.body: Hungry animals go after their favourite fruit. Tap them before they take a bite.

crittersLead: From level 3, animals sneak onto the board to eat their favourite fruit. Tap them to shoo them away for +50 points.
progressNote: Play a game and your records show up here. They stay on this device.
dailyDescription: One fruit-matching board a day, the same for every player. Play today's challenge free in your browser.
achDescription: Achievements you can earn in Fruit Destroy on this device: combos, high scores, daily challenges and perfect clears.

modes.title: Classic
modes.body: Level by level, with more fruit types, more pairs and more critters as you go. Earn up to 3 stars per level.

modes.title: Endless
modes.body: New pairs keep dropping, faster and faster. Keep the board from filling up for as long as you can.

modes.title: Daily
modes.body: One new board a day, the same for every player. One official run — then compare with friends.

modes.title: Time Attack
modes.body: Sixty seconds. Score as much as you can before the clock or the board runs out.

faq.a: Yes. Every mode is free to play in your browser, with no download and no sign-up.
Yes. Fruit Destroy runs in any modern browser on phones, tablets and computers.
Yes. There is no violence or chat, and the rules are simple: find two of the same fruit.
Your levels, best scores and daily streak are saved on your device.

ctaLead: One tap to start. No account, no download.
